rules: Tonal cold blues from jacket to jeans; the only colour comes from the shoes.
Deconstructed outerwear (visible seams, patch panels) carries the interest, so everything else stays plain.
Wide jeans break over chunky shoes; the shoe is the heaviest point of the lower half.
Face covered: the clothes are the whole message.
